teaser: The truck sits half-unloaded at the curb at seven in the morning, boxes taped on one side, open on the other, when you decide the whole load needs sorting from scratch. You are a 4, the builder, and an ENTP, the debater, and that gap shows before the day even starts. The 4 wants the boxes sealed, arranged, accounted for. The ENTP wants to argue with the system itself, to find a better way to pack a truck no one asked you to redesign. What is particular here is not the tension, it is how often the rebuilding looks like progress.
